failure_fact.reason: Post-hit scalar scoring only removes a small amount of materialization or callback-placement cost. It does not reduce traversal work, candidate count, or high-volume hit attribute movement enough to support formal high-performance V4.

selection.next_goal: Goal4713 custom predicate early-exit multi-hit protocol freeze

rejected_patterns.reason: Goal4711 already measured this shape at about 1.029x geomean; more wording or minor polish is not a new lever.
Weighted sum exists in V2/V3 and is control-only, not V4-specific app evidence.
Goal4711 smoke showed global atomic accumulation is a diagnostic control, not a performance route.
Rerunning the same custom-scored app cannot move the frozen bar unless the mechanism changes.

selected_target_contract.allowed_callback_shape: pure scalar/boolean Numba C-ABI device function with no side effects
selected_target_contract.engine_owned_action: RTDL applies terminate_on_first_accept or count_until_threshold; user callback does not mutate external state
selected_target_contract.generic_feature_under_test: constrained custom predicate callback in any-hit with RTDL-owned early-exit policy
selected_target_contract.minimum_bar_to_consider_formal_hp: Goal4713 must freeze numeric bars; expected bar should require material speedup in high-candidate regimes, not a 1.03x polish win
selected_target_contract.must_freeze_before_pod: correctness oracle, candidate density, scales, callback variants, V2/V3 fallback, numeric bars, kill conditions, and public-claim boundaries
selected_target_contract.required_scene_shape: multi-hit rays with frozen candidate densities, e.g. >=8 and >=32 possible hits per ray, plus sparse/no-hit controls
selected_target_contract.v2_v3_denominator: same OptiX hit discovery with device materialization of all candidate IDs/attributes, followed by separate device predicate/filter/reduction
selected_target_contract.v4_route: callback predicate evaluated inside any-hit with early termination/filtering controlled by RTDL
selected_target_contract.why_this_can_win: Unlike post-hit accumulation, a predicate callback can affect traversal-side control flow. V4 can reject or terminate inside any-hit before materializing every candidate, while V2/V3 fallback must materialize all hit IDs or hit attributes and then run a separate device predicate/filter.
